signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Use your clinic account. Sessions end after 15 minutes of inactivity.
signIn.footer: Access is logged. Patient data is protected; don’t share your account.

errors.invalid_one: Email or password is incorrect. {{count}} attempt left.
errors.invalid_other: Email or password is incorrect. {{count}} attempts left.
errors.locked: Too many attempts. This account is locked for 15 minutes.
errors.deactivated: This account has been deactivated. Contact your clinic administrator.
errors.noTenant: This account isn’t linked to a clinic yet. Contact your clinic administrator.
errors.generic: Sign-in failed. Try again in a moment.

notices.expired: You were signed out after 15 minutes of inactivity. Sign in again to continue.
notices.suspended: This clinic’s account is suspended. Contact support.

setPassword.title: Set a new password
setPassword.intro: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose your own to continue.

errors.unchanged: Choose a password different from the temporary one.
errors.generic: Couldn’t save the password. Try again.
